hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' && { if echo "$f" | grep -q '/backend/'; then pnpm --filter backend typecheck; elif echo "$f" | grep -q '/frontend/'; then pnpm --filter frontend typecheck; else pnpm typecheck; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.test\.(ts|tsx)$' && { if echo "$f" | grep -q '/backend/'; then NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' pnpm --filter backend test; elif echo "$f" | grep -q '/frontend/'; then NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' pnpm --filter frontend test; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
